claims.claim_text: The indexed Technician Fourth Grade Otis L. Ausen is strongly matched to the Otis Ausen listed with the OSS Norwegian Operational Group.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The historical personnel roster lists Otis Ausen at the same uncommon name and enlisted grade in OSS Norwegian operations.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence: the exact distinctive surname and given name, matching middle initial, matching Technician Fourth Grade, and explicit OSS Norwegian Operational Group context align with the visually verified Box 26 row.
claims.temporal_assessment: The roster establishes wartime OSS assignment context, not a pre-OSS employer or the date of entry into OSS.
claims.match_notes: The matching uncommon name, initial, rank, and OSS context exceed a name-only match. Direct personnel-file or private-identifier confirmation remains necessary.
